analysis: Documentation-only PR. docs/developer/test.md (head lines 45-51, 53-99) adds MiMo FP32 preflight fixture notes and a Startup Performance Recovery test section. docs/operations/provider-release.md (patch hunk @@ -14,8 +15) records the 0.9.21 candidate: startup health-check timings excluded from throughput learning, bounded calibration for ordinary autoregressive and native block engines without a customer job, and a pinned mlx-swift-lm #305 dependency. v0.9.20 is marked published. No code, workflow, key handling, attestation, authorization, encryption, or billing behavior changes. The release-process statements remain consistent with the canonical model: preparation does not tag/register/publish; trusted-master and signed-tag gates remain; official registration does not grant serving authorization (TB-011, A-016, A-017). The new calibration behavior is only described. If the underlying code changes reach the provider (not in this PR), they could affect availability/capacity reporting and throughput-based routing evidence; they touch TB-002 and T-010 only indirectly, and the next pass should check that calibration is local and uses no customer plaintext (A-001), and that its heartbeat or throughput claims do not become trust or authorization evidence (T-052, T-056). No concrete security regression is visible in these docs.
